title_backdrop.prompt: A wide night landscape of Wickermoor Hollow in the right two thirds of the picture: an enormous pale cream-white full moon low in the upper right sky, lopsided, with a huge crooked toothy grin and narrow slanted glowing eyes, a smirking face in the moon; beneath it a huddle of crooked leaning village roofs with warm lantern-orange windows and carved turnip jack-o'-lanterns glowing on the doorposts, in the right foreground the gnarled Oak of Many Faces, its thick trunk and branches covered in pale screaming faces, purple moor mist rolling between the roofs, a tiny wicker giant silhouetted on a far hill with a thread of orange firelight, dead cornstalks, a few bats crossing the moon. The left third of the picture is dark empty indigo sky and black ground. Wide cinematic frame, no text, no lettering.
